description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Wind-Scarred Crag from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Play Wind-Scarred Crag, triggering it and Fastbond.
Resolve the Wind-Scarred Crag trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Fastbond trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat.
